# Built-in templates

Ready-made models a city can place without defining a blueprint: `"source": "tpl:<id>"`.
Cells = footprint in city cells at s=1, rot=0 (a cell is 8 studs; x s for a scaled placement, swapped for odd rot).
Templates tagged `water` must sit on (or across) water; all others on dry land.
